text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm about to open three linked PRs (API, SDK, console) that need a coordinated merge order. API adds an optional enum to the inference response (proto), SDK exposes it, console adds a tiny UX flag. Helm chart needs a chart version bump and runtime image tag. Can we coordinate approvals so nothing breaks in staging?

alex: high-level plan:
- API PR merges first (backcompat-preserving)
- SDK: bump proto deps, run integration tests, publish tag
- Console: point at new SDK tag and merge UI change
- Helm/runtime: update image tag + Chart.yaml version and cut deploy

alex: proto diff (very small):
```proto
message InferenceResult {
  oneof payload {
    string text = 1;
  }
  enum ConfidenceBand {
    UNKNOWN = 0;
    HIGH = 1;
    MEDIUM = 2;
    LOW = 3;
  }
  ConfidenceBand confidence = 5; // new optional field, default UNKNOWN
}
```

maria: Thanks for the heads-up. Important: ensure the enum default stays UNKNOWN and we treat missing field as UNKNOWN in all languages. Add a short rollout note in the API PR description so we can track consumers. I'll review the API change today.

devon: SDK heads-up — I tried pulling the branch locally and tests fail because the generated protos are different. I'll wait for API to merge then regenerate and push a tag. Can you paste the API PR URL? Also we should gate the SDK publish on the CI integration job passing against staging API.

alex: API PR: https://git.redwood/infra/api/pulls/4123 (contains migration notes). SDK draft: https://git.redwood/infra/sdk/pulls/2108. Console PR: https://git.redwood/infra/console/pulls/883. Helm runtime chart change will be a tiny PR after the runtime image is built.

sam: Console: UI changes are trivial (shows confidence dot + tooltip). I can keep console PR ready but will rebase on the SDK release tag. Expect no design risk.

ci-bot: API CI: all checks passed ✅ 
ci-bot: SDK CI (on branch): integration tests failing (proto mismatch) ❌

devon: OK I'll approve SDK once API is merged and I push a 0.14.2 tag. Can we do a canary deploy after helm bump? Need a short window to smoke-test model endpoints.

maria: I'll add the rollout note and a short compatibility section to the API PR describing that missing field = UNKNOWN and we won't add new numeric values without a minor version bump. You can :eyes: the note at the top.

alex: Suggested merge checklist (alex -> devon -> sam -> ops):
1) API PR merged by maria (confirm rollout note)
2) SDK: regen protos, run unit+integration, publish tag `v0.14.2` (devon)
3) Console: update package.json / go.mod to tag, merge (sam)
4) Runtime: ops picks up runtime image `redwood/runtime:2026-03-17-rc1`, bump Chart.yaml version and merge helm PR (ops)
5) Canary deploy for 30m, then full rollout.

alex: quick commands for helm bump if helpful:
```bash
# bump chart version
sed -i 's/^version: .*/version: 1.3.5/' charts/runtime/Chart.yaml
# set image tag
yq eval '.image.tag = "2026-03-17-rc1"' -i charts/runtime/values.yaml
```

devon: That order works for me. I'll watch the api merge and aim to publish the SDK tag within 30m of merge. CI will gate the publish.

maria: Reviewing now. If all good I'll merge and add the changelog note. :shipit:

sam: I'll queue the console PR rebase once devon publishes the tag.

alex: Great — pinging @devon @maria @sam for approvals when ready. If anyone wants a different order or sees a compatibility risk speak up now. :eyes:
